confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web searches that returned crowd-sourced cost-of-living aggregates for Pai (Numbeo, Citycost, NomadRanker and others). Their medians were roughly 65 baht for an inexpensive meal, 80 baht for a draft beer, 59 to 69 baht for a cappuccino, and 650 to 800 baht for a mid-range dinner for two. Sources differ widely, especially on the mid-range meal, and prices rise in peak season. Cocktail and wine have little Pai-specific data. Cocktails are based on a few scattered reports of about 80 to 160 baht. Wine is estimated as a premium over beer because imported wine is expensive in Thailand. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings. They are the least certain because Pai guesthouse and hostel prices swing a lot between high and low season. The FX rate is the latest RBA observation found, for 18 November 2026. It is a USD-per-AUD quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai is a small, backpacker-oriented northern Thai town. Its prices are similar to or slightly above Chiang Mai street-level and local-restaurant prices, with a tourist premium for bars and cafes. Accommodation is a hostel and bungalow market with wide seasonal variation.
